candidateThemes.reason: Actual durable pipeline and AI-failure checks ran, but crash/outage/scheduled recovery remain limited by recorded failures or deadlines.
items: C1
Observed 100 graded of 100 accepted in 70973.125911 ms.
Real API, MongoDB, hosted Redis, separate unmodified worker; local mock Judge0, mock LLM. Registration excluded from drain timing.
H1
Observed 20 graded with 20 feedback failures after retries.
Live separate worker + real BullMQ retry/backoff. Judge0 and LLM mocked. Polling resolution 250 ms; timing includes enqueue/dispatch.
H2
Observed abort at 60003.54567100001 ms with grading graded.
Actual feedback processor/chain; mock never resolves and does not cooperate with cancellation. Direct processor call has no runner to set feedback failed; grading remains committed.
H4
Verified 3 distinct mock AI failure modes did not block committed grading.
Distinct AI failures only. Direct malformed-output retries omit queue backoff; throwing mode uses real queue retries. Standalone H4 reports only its own mode.

candidateThemes.theme: Approval workflow and injection state isolation
candidateThemes.reason: Real saves/routes and hostile model outputs exercised the state boundary; the requested matrix has diagonal deviations and the real-model subset has missing outputs.
items: D2
Observed 0 non-approved leaks, 8 student review denials, and 4 terminal-review rejections.
Real routes; in-memory general limiter; temporary MongoDB.
D3a
All 28 malicious-mock drafts were pending; 0 set privileged fields.
Mock emits hostile JSON text plus AIMessage privileged metadata. Actual chain and doubt processor used; no evidence of real-model semantic resistance.
D3a
Observed 28 schema-valid text outputs.
Mock emits hostile JSON text plus AIMessage privileged metadata. Actual chain and doubt processor used; no evidence of real-model semantic resistance.
D3b
2 pending drafts from 5 real-provider attempts; errors are reported separately.
At most five provider invocations, no retries. Limited corpus; approval state is still set by application code.

candidateThemes.reason: Real Redis quotas and bounded real Judge0 probes were measured; filesystem/shell probes completed inside Judge0, so the data cannot support broad isolation claims.
items: A2
Observed 2 acceptances from 20 overlapping requests.
Real Redis-backed middleware race, one API process.
A5
With Redis unavailable, 2 requests were accepted and 2 rate-limited; latest request latency was at most 2983.6259339999997 ms.
Second real development API; Redis at a closed port; insurance limiter with bounded Redis connect/command timeouts. This tests one API process and does not prove multi-process outage coordination.
A6
Observed 120 successful and 10 limited authenticated reads.
Real authenticated middleware and Redis; fresh user.
B4
Judge0 returned 5242880 bytes; the updated student-visible output is 4096 bytes and carries the truncation marker.

Real Judge0 through a counted proxy; real API + BullMQ worker when Redis is available, direct grading processor otherwise. Bounded probes; output flood records the post-cap student-visible output size. Accepted filesystem/shell probes are not counted as terminated/errored containment.
B1–B7
5 of 7 adversarial probes terminated or errored; 9 total real Judge0 HTTP requests were spent including the recheck.
Real provider, bounded sources; file/shell completion and Unicode are separated.

candidateThemes.reason: Stored rewards/notifications and targeted auth checks held, while E1 directly demonstrates repeated external grading calls.
items: E2
50 completion calls persisted 100 XP, 1 event and 0 duplicate badges.
Real Mongo unique indexes and production completion code; one process, one successful easy solve; no queue transport.
E3
10 notification triggers persisted 1 notification.
Concurrent direct approved-answer notification path; real MongoDB.
G1
1 of 10 refresh attempts succeeded in the latest race; sibling reuse returned 401.
Real refresh route and MongoDB; sibling was validated before the race. No tokens are recorded.
G5
11 student forbiddens and 11 anonymous unauthenticated responses across 11 routes.
Every teacher-only method/path in current route files, including the jobs router-level guard. Invalid IDs intentionally generated as valid ObjectIds; role guards precede validation/domain lookup.

candidateThemes.reason: The paired before/after query run used the same generated dataset and request sample count; the result still applies to one local process and a synthetic database.
items: F1
On 5000 synthetic doubts at concurrency 50, first-page p95 changed from 12544.258505999998 ms to 270.49615800000174 ms across 100 requests per run (97.84366562702274% lower).
Same synthetic seed and local route harness; baseline returned the unpaginated collection, follow-up returned a cursor page of 20. One machine, one API process, temporary MongoDB.
F2
The Doubt page query examined 21 and returned 21 records using createdAt_-1__id_-1; 2 other explained queries still used COLLSCAN.

ExecutionStats from primary route query shapes. Doubt board explain uses the 21-row fetch needed to return one page of 20 plus its hasMore check. Cursor nReturned and aggregate final nReturned differ. Auxiliary auth, populate and approved-answer queries are outside these five explains.
J1
126 backend tests passed; coverage was 79.73 statements, 63.72 branches, 83.9 functions, 82.94 lines.
Existing full backend suite; its setup uses temporary MongoDB and mocked external services. Coverage applies to imported files, not a security guarantee.
J2/J3
57 frontend tests passed; both current audits reported 0 and 0 total advisories.
Existing frontend suite in jsdom, not a real-browser test. No dependencies/configuration changed to enable coverage.
J4
14 lazy route chunks; initial static JavaScript gzip size 216658 bytes.
Actual production build. Initial-load JS determined from manifest static-import closure. No remote Monaco downloads or API payloads included.

doNotClaim: Do not claim general security, complete sandbox isolation, or an availability percentage.
Do not claim exactly-once processing or exactly-once Judge0 calls: direct concurrent grading replay repeated the external call.
Do not claim the strict requested approval matrix passed: diagonal no-op saves were accepted.
Do not describe a pending Answer as proof the real model ignored an injection. Missing real-model outputs establish no injection-resistance result.
Do not call the accelerated daily check a real-day expiration test. The fail-fast outage result covers one API process and does not prove shared quotas during a multi-process outage.
Do not call a deadline-limited unfinished submission permanently lost. Do not claim horizontal scaling or a production capacity gain from incomplete or mock-only runs.
Do not present mocked grading outputs as arbitrary-program correctness or real provider performance.
Do not claim all hot queries use indexes. The recorded collection scans remain.
Do not call local production cookie headers a deployed HTTPS/browser verification.
Do not claim a statistically reliable production tail from the finite local latency sample, or cache expiry from a quick cached pair.
Do not claim frontend coverage or Lighthouse scores when those subchecks were skipped.
Do not call a clean npm audit proof of no vulnerabilities, or test coverage proof of complete correctness.

changes.change: Shared GET /doubts now defaults to 20-item cursor pages; callers can request up to 100. ?mine=1 without limit keeps its prior full own-doubts response.
Declared compound indexes for board createdAt/_id ordering and per-student studentId/createdAt/_id ordering.
Rejected CORS origin callback now carries HTTP status 403.
Bound Redis connect and command waits, retries, and disabled offline command queuing for the API Redis client.
Grading still compares complete provider output, then stores at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes of actualOutput and marks truncation in text.
